title: phpLDAPadmin console is reachable without authentication
description: The phpLDAPadmin interface is served without authentication. Its login form accepts a bind DN, and its tree editor writes to the directory once a bind succeeds.
remediation: Restrict phpLDAPadmin to the administrative network and require client certificates or an authenticating proxy in front of it.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the phpLDAPadmin console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · phpLDAPadmin</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
